name: Ashwall Tier-Hop Courier Full Transit Rig
description:
Built for moving through every tier in a single shift. Core layer: a slim-cut reversible jacket — Circuit grey on one face, Tier 3 charcoal professional on the other, each side clean enough to pass. Underneath: a collarless base layer in neutral sand that reads as deliberate minimalism above Tier 2. Slim cargo trousers with hidden compartments at the thigh and calf, tailored enough for a Tier 4 lobby. Shoes split the difference — clean enough for an elevator, grippy enough for a fire escape.

Hood with integrated filter, collapsible into a collar. Neural port cap is a neutral brushed-metal — no corporate logo. Everything folds flat into the sling bag.
functionality: Reversible jacket for rapid tier-presentation switching, hidden cargo compartments at thigh and calf, collapsible filter hood, neutral BCI port cap with no identifying markings, grippy-yet-clean sole profile, and full kit packs flat into a standard sling bag.
what_it_says: You belong everywhere and nowhere, and you've made a living out of the fact that no one can quite place you.
worn_by: info brokers doing their own runs
journalists working protected sources across tier lines
story_hooks: The hidden calf compartment contains a sealed package that's been there for three weeks — the client who sent it has stopped responding to messages.
A Tier 4 security AI has flagged this outfit's thermal signature twice in the same building; someone is pattern-matching the courier's routes.
The reversible jacket's Circuit-grey side has a small hand-drawn mark inside the collar — a the Gray Zone gang sign indicating this person is under informal protection.
related_entities: TESSERA CORPONATION Aegis CorpSec Hardened Security BCI

physical_description.visual_profile: A deliberately neutral, shape-shifting silhouette designed to pass unnoticed across social strata. The reversible jacket is the statement piece — slim, modern, neither ostentatiously wealthy nor visibly struggling. The overall impression is fluid, adaptive, professional-enough without being corporate-coded. Built for movement and transition rather than status display.
physical_description.fit: Slim and tailored through the torso and shoulders, allowing layering without bulk. Cargo trousers have a clean, almost minimalist cut at the hip and thigh, tapering slightly at the ankle. The jacket is contoured but not tight — designed to move with the wearer. Everything sits close enough to not snag on infrastructure, loose enough to allow augmentation beneath.
physical_description.primary_material: Reversible ballistic weave (Circuit grey / charcoal blend on exterior faces), collarless base layer in treated organic-synthetic hybrid, cargo trousers in durable ripstop composite with reinforced seams
physical_description.texture: Smooth, water-resistant exterior with a subtle matte finish that avoids reflective glint. Interior of reversible jacket has a softer brushed weave. Base layer is nearly frictionless against skin. Thigh and calf compartments have reinforced, slightly raised stitching — tactile to find by touch in dark.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: Circuit grey (weathered silver-blue with faint grid texture on one jacket face), Tier 3 charcoal (muted, professional grey on reverse). Accent: warm sand/taupe base layer, brushed-metal grey (neural port cap and zipper hardware). Shoes in scuffed neutral tan with dark grip sole.
physical_description.closures: Main jacket: magnetic snap system (reversible, works on both sides) with optional friction-fit magnetic collar clips. Cargo trousers: concealed YKK friction-lock zippers on thigh and calf compartments, main fly is standard magnetic. Hood filter system uses pressure-seal clips. Sling bag has reinforced Velcro and snap closures.
distinctive_features: Reversible jacket — two completely different tier-appropriate faces, seamless construction
Integrated hood with collapsible filter (packs into high collar when stowed)
Neural port cap in neutral brushed-metal, no corporate branding or street insignia
Hidden thigh and calf compartments with reinforced, tactile stitching for rapid access
Sling bag designed to compress flat and fold into the jacket's back panel pocket
All seams are sealed with thermal tape — waterproof and minimally visible
Shoe soles are hybrid grip-pattern, designed for both smooth corporate floors and rough fire escapes
Interior lining has faint grid pattern — memory marker for compartment locations
physical_description.tier_indicator: Deliberately ambiguous — Tier 1-2 on Circuit grey side, Tier 3-4 on charcoal side. The design is explicitly anti-status, signaling someone who moves between worlds rather than claims one.
physical_description.cultural_context: Courier, runner, fixer, or anyone whose safety depends on not being readable. The wearer is in transit, in motion, in the liminal spaces. Worn by people who work the gaps between tiers — deliverers of information, goods, or services that flow upward and downward. No corporate allegiance visible, no street crew colors. Neutral enough to be trusted nowhere and everywhere.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new, but designed to break in gracefully. Expected to show subtle wear: creasing at the elbows and knee folds, faint scuffs on shoe grip, maybe one or two small thermal-sealed repairs on the seams. Never looks destroyed — always looks *maintained*. The reversibility means a tired-looking charcoal side can be flipped to a fresher Circuit grey for a high-tier run.
